description: Author-curated, literature-informed architectural hypotheses for the existing scalar FE surrogate. Not a published or validated surrogate rule benchmark.
selection: Seeded permutation without replacement of applicable rules per audit; no performance ranking or LLM proposal selection.
numeric_choices: Width factors, latent factors, depth steps and dropout values are project design choices, not values established by the cited papers.
construction_note: Frozen after observing earlier project results, including the NoReflector/NoProposer pilot. Future comparisons are exploratory; do not treat this library as preregistered before those results.

excluded_nader_rules.grouped_convolution: No convolution/group operator in the current surrogate schema.
excluded_nader_rules.depthwise_separable_convolution: CNN operator absent from the current schema.
excluded_nader_rules.increase_kernel_size: No convolution kernel in the current schema.
excluded_nader_rules.squeeze_and_excitation: SE blocks are not implemented by the factory.
excluded_nader_rules.swap_activation_normalization: Layer ordering cannot be changed through the current architecture JSON.
excluded_nader_rules.inverted_bottleneck: A block expansion/projection operator is not exposed; latent expansion below is only a compression-capacity analogue.
excluded_nader_rules.cascade_and_parallel: The schema does not expose arbitrary block composition. Adding a supported encoder layer is a limited project adaptation, not NADER graph composition.

rules.intent: Test residual encoder connections while preserving widths and depth.
rules.adaptation: Map CNN residual motivation to the factory's existing dense residual encoder.

rules.intent: Test the plain MLP encoder as the simpler alternative to residual blocks.
rules.adaptation: Project control; no claim that removing skips improves performance.

rules.intent: Test reduced encoder capacity and parameter cost.
rules.adaptation: Capacity-control analogue; factor is a project choice.

rules.intent: Test increased encoder capacity without adding layers.
rules.adaptation: Bounded capacity hypothesis; factor is a project choice.

rules.intent: Test a shallower encoder by removing its terminal hidden layer.
rules.adaptation: Architecture simplification; training budget remains fixed.

rules.intent: Test one additional terminal encoder layer for nonlinear representation.
rules.adaptation: Only the existing sequential encoder is extended; no arbitrary graph composition.

rules.intent: Test stronger compression of the learned latent representation.
rules.adaptation: Analogue of bottleneck compression, not a convolutional bottleneck block.

rules.intent: Test a less restrictive learned latent representation.
rules.adaptation: Project capacity counterpart to latent compression; not an inverted CNN bottleneck.

rules.intent: Test the existing lightweight MLP predictor instead of attention.
rules.adaptation: Use the implemented MLP head; not an exact reproduction of the paper's models.

rules.intent: Test the existing bar-token Transformer predictor for interactions.
rules.adaptation: The existing bar-token factory is not FT-Transformer. Required width/head compatibility is resolved by code.

rules.intent: Test batch normalization as the encoder normalization method.
rules.adaptation: Applies to supported encoder normalization, not all Transformer internals.

rules.intent: Test per-sample layer normalization in the encoder.
rules.adaptation: Changes only the encoder field exposed by this factory.

rules.intent: Test whether explicit encoder normalization is necessary.
rules.adaptation: Project control; not a literature guarantee of better fitting.

rules.intent: Test ReLU as the simple encoder activation control.
rules.adaptation: Keep all non-activation fields fixed.

rules.intent: Test GELU in the encoder while retaining predictor activation.
rules.adaptation: Transfer a general activation hypothesis to this regression surrogate.

rules.intent: Test SiLU in the encoder while retaining predictor activation.
rules.adaptation: SiLU corresponds to the beta=1 Swish form.

rules.intent: Test ReLU in the prediction head while preserving encoder activation.
rules.adaptation: Only the head activation field changes.

rules.intent: Test GELU in the prediction head while preserving encoder activation.
rules.adaptation: Does not alter the hard-coded internal Transformer activation.

rules.intent: Test SiLU in the prediction head while preserving encoder activation.
rules.adaptation: Only the head activation field changes.

rules.intent: Test weaker but nonzero dropout regularization.
rules.adaptation: Value chosen for this project; nonzero to retain MC-dropout sampling.

rules.intent: Test moderate dropout regularization.
rules.adaptation: Project control value, not a paper-derived optimum.

rules.intent: Test stronger dropout regularization without changing training settings.
rules.adaptation: Project choice; stronger regularization can also cause underfitting.
